# host a room alone: HOST A ROOM, the room is made on the service, 45 s in the waiting popup, cancel, back to the main menu
# Generated by tools/console-1.2/gen_online.py (edit the generator, not this file). One console, the real online service, no opponent: POST /v1/rooms, the endpoint (STUN or, with MSC_NET_RELAY_ONLY=1, the TURN relay first), polled while nobody joins; Circle leaves the room (DELETE)
# Menus are driven by pad presses only; the public name comes from MSC_ONLINE_NAME in the run's np-player.txt (nothing is typed). Every screen logs a STATE line: a missing one is a TIMEOUT
# line of the script and the run is INVALID.
mash 100 20 scene == 0
log STATE title screen
mash 100 30 scene != 0
wait scene == 1 || scene == 10
wait scene == 10 || nbuttons >= 8
if scene == 10
log first run: no save file, accepting 'create save data'
wait nbuttons >= 2
idle 10
mash 100 30 scene == 1
wait nbuttons >= 8
endif
wait onctx == 0
log STATE main menu
idle 30
# The main menu is a ring picked by stick/D-pad angle; Multiplayer (ctx 1) is up-left.
hold 30 0 -80 80
wait onctx == 1 120
idle 10
log STATE pointer on multiplayer
idle 20
press 100
wait scene == 10 1200
log STATE multiplayer mode choice
wait nbuttons >= 3 900
idle 60
mash 8 15 onctx == 0 180
idle 10
press 100
log chose online
wait scene == 1 900
wait scene == 10 1200
wait nbuttons >= 3 900
log STATE online choice popup
idle 60
idle 10
press 100
log chose host
# the account step, the room and the transport: the game's status popup (its one button cancels). A failure popup would also have a button: the log's
# `[online-menu] failure:` line tells them apart (online_check.py).
wait nbuttons >= 1 3600
idle 300
log STATE room status popup
idle 1350
log STATE room waited
press 200
idle 240
log STATE room cancelled
# back out to the main menu: Circle leaves a scene one step at a time (player count -> hub -> main menu); a Circle that is not needed is not pressed
idle 60
if scene != 1
press 200
idle 180
endif
if scene != 1
press 200
idle 180
endif
if scene != 1
press 200
idle 180
endif
wait scene == 1 900
idle 150
log STATE back in the main menu
exit
